main_text.p: בֹּחַן m. Probatio; Munitio, Ezech.21.13. Jes.28.16.
בְּחוֹן m. Specula exploratoria, vel juxta quosdā, Turris munita, Jer.6.27. Plural. cum Schurek & Aff. בְּחוֹנָיו Speculas ejus, Jesa.23.13. à sing. בְּחוֹן forma תָּנּוּר.

בָּחַר Elegit, Selegit: ferè cum Præpositione ב construitur. Præter. בְּךָ בָּחַר Te selegit, Deut.7.6. Niph. Præt. וְנִבְחַר Et eligetur, electa erit, Jer.8.3. Part. נִבְחָר Selectum, Lectissimum, Prov.8.10. Pyh. Fut. יִבְחַר Eligetur, Eccles.9.4. ubi juxta Masorethas legendum יִחְבַּר Associabitur.

בָּחוּר m. Lectus, Electus: Item Juvenis, quasi ad omnes operas Selectus, Ezech.9.6. Plur.constr. בְּחוּרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל Juvenum Israelis, 1.Sam.26.2. Et plurale alterius formæ, בְּחוּרִים Psal.148.12. à sing. בָּחוּר forma תָּגוּר ex Dagessatus: Sic quoq; juxta quosdam Jesa.42.22. Constr. בְּחוּרֵי Juvenes, Ezech.23.v.6. Aff. בְּחוּרֵיהֶם Juvenes eorum, 2.Paral.36.17.
בְּחוּרִים m.p. Juventus, quasi atas Selecta: Aff. מִבְּחֻרָיו A' Juventute sua, Num.11.28.
בְּחֻרוֹת f.p. Idem: Aff. בִּימֵי בְּחֻרוֹתֶיךָ In diebus juventutis tuæ, Eccles.12.1.
בָּחִיר m. Electus: Constru. בְּחִיר, 2.Sam.21.6. Aff. בְּחִירִי Electus meus, Jesa.42.1. Plural. cum Aff. בְּחִירָיו Electi ejus, Psal.105.6.
מִבְחָר m. Idem: Constru. מִבְחַר בְּחוּרָיו Selectissimum Juvenum ejus, Jerem.48.15. Plur. cum Aff. מִבְחֲרָיו Delectuum ejus, Dan.11.15.
בָּטַא Pronuntiavit, Effutivit: Particip. בֹּטֵא Effutiens, Prov.13.18. ex formâ Quiescentium tertiâ

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some Hebrew forms (e.g. תָּגוּר, תָּנּוּר, יִחְבַּר, מִבְחֲרָיו) are small and hard to read at this scan resolution; they are copied as far as they can be seen but may contain errors. The running head is Hebrew letters as printed. The page is set in roman type with Hebrew entries, and the large Hebrew headwords (בֹּחַן, בָּחַר, בָּחוּר, בָּטַא) are kept at the start of their entries.
